title: solid routine planner and habit tracker
body: The app is packed with pretty useful features that helps you plan your daily routines and track your habits. The addition of a welcome video is also a nice touch, it essentially gives the overview of the app. The feature I like the most is the premade habits. If you have a lot of habits to track, it can become tedious to make them, but this app already has premade ones that you could just press to add to your routine. I also like the stats visualization, it makes you want to keep doing more and improve yourself.
author: brrtbrrt07

title: Free & portable life coach
body:
I’ve been dealing with a lot of factors in life that hinders me from achieving my goals and is causing me harm in the long run. The starting steps on the app are easy to go through. Just tick from the selections, such as poor sleep, bad diet, too much screen time, and so on.

It gave me a protocol that’s optimal to my current situation and it doesn’t pressure you into going all out, just like a life coach who’s understanding.

The app interface is cool on the eyes. Main menu contains 5 items and one should start adding a habit in the daily routine page before you’re able to make use of the others. Each habit that you add is completely customizable. From the number of times you do it in a week, time of the day, it’s all up to the user and their goal.

This is speaking as a free user, great app for me who needs guide in self improvement
author: Frosteeflow

title: app review
body:
I wanted to love this app the concept sounds fantastic, but using it for a while left me pretty disappointed. While the design is nice, a lot of the features felt repetitive and not as tailored as I thought they would be. A few really generalized recommendations were neither unique nor effective in helping me maintain motivation.

And It seems to me the app is trying to sell subscription too force but they dont actually providing enough. Considering the price point, I wanted more bang for my buck and a better overall experience. It was also very frustrating because cancellation wasn’t super easy.
